requests.title: Approve Guard exercise 2: two-lane pack?
requests.question:
@cos finished Guard exercise 2: two-lane pack (GUARD-9) and the review is in. Nothing else moves until you call it.

This Issue's lanes delivered 2 file(s):

- team/accounts/guard-quote.md
- team/emails/guard-email.md

The Issue ships no single file of its own; those are what you are accepting.
Approve and the lane closes. Send it back and the owner picks up your note as the rework.

requests.title: Human interview
requests.question: 这个 exercise 说「two independent files, one per lane」，但两条 lane 在我能读到的任何地方都没有定义——team wiki 是空的，任务包只点名了三个系统技能（data-modeling、app-building、wiki-maintenance）。这两条 lane 应该是什么？
requests.context: GUARD-1 要的是一个「two-lane pack」：两份独立的 wiki 文章，每份对应一条 lane。我查过 team wiki（目前没有任何文章），也查过任务包（只有三个系统技能）。没有你的定义，我无法命名这两条 lane，也不能凭空编。你告诉我之后，我会在 GUARD-1 下建两个子任务——每条 lane 一篇文章——然后交付到 wiki。

options.label: Guard 策略 + Guard 测试
options.description: 一篇文章定义 guard 策略，一篇讲它如何被 enforcement / 测试。

options.label: 两个系统技能
options.description: data-modeling 和 app-building 各一篇文章。

options.label: 两个 guard 场景
options.description: 每个场景一篇文章（例如 prompt injection、data exfiltration）。

options.label: Something else
options.description: None of these fit — write your own answer.
options.text_hint: Type your own answer for the team.
